name: flow
description: Standalone orchestration for software development in Claude Code: managers, workers in their own git worktrees and one reviewer run your tasks in parallel, and only decisions reach you

test_command.title: Test command
test_command.description: What a worker runs to check its package, e.g. npm test. Empty: the tests covering the changed files.

full_check_command.title: Full check
full_check_command.description: What the reviewer runs once per batch before pushing, e.g. npm run check. Empty: no full check (the reviewer says so).

deploy_command.title: Deploy command
deploy_command.description: What the reviewer runs after pushing. Empty: no deploy.

merge_method.title: Merge method without a reviewer
merge_method.description: gh pr merge method managers use when the reviewer is off.

merge_mode.title: Merge mode
merge_mode.description: auto: the reviewer merges approved PRs. confirm: it waits for you to run /flow approve <pr>. A flow:confirm or flow:auto label on a PR overrides this.

push_mode.title: Push mode
push_mode.description: auto: the reviewer pushes a batch once its full check is green. confirm: it builds and checks the batch, saves it and stops; you start the push with /flow push.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: On: managers hand PRs to one reviewer, which merges, runs the full check and deploys. Off: managers merge themselves.

max_managers.title: Managers at once
max_managers.description: How many managers the main session runs at a time.

max_workers.title: Workers per manager
max_workers.description: How many workers one manager runs at a time.

test_slots.title: Test slots
test_slots.description: How many heavy test runs (a whole suite, the full check) may run at once across all agents of the session. Minimum 1.

context_warn_percent.title: Context warning
context_warn_percent.description: The Flow pane marks this percent of the context window on each agent's meter, and the meter turns yellow at or past it (1 to 100). Applies to windows under 1M.

context_warn_percent_1m.title: Context warning, 1M window
context_warn_percent_1m.description: The same as the context warning, for agents on a 1M window (a [1m] model). The 200k percent never applies to them (1 to 100).

context_warn_tokens.title: Context limit in tokens
context_warn_tokens.description: An optional cap over both percents: hand off at this many tokens, or at the percent of the window when that is lower (0 = off, percent only). Also places the meter marker.

handoff.title: Handoff
handoff.description: On: a worker or manager that reaches the context warning percent is told to commit, push and write a handoff note, and its parent continues on a fresh agent. Off: the meter only shows.

main_checkout_guard.title: Main-checkout guard
main_checkout_guard.description: On: Edit, Write and obvious shell writes (redirects, sed -i, git commit and friends) aimed at the repo's main checkout are refused, for every flow agent and the main session. Worktrees and .git/ stay writable.

main_checkout_allow.title: Main checkout: still writable
main_checkout_allow.description: Comma-separated paths relative to the repo root that stay writable in the main checkout; one ending in / covers a directory.

max_continues.title: Max continues
max_continues.description: After a branch has handed off this many times, the owning manager is told the package is too big and should be split. It only warns.

worker_model_small.title: Worker model, small briefs
worker_model_small.description: Model alias for workers whose brief says `Size: small`. Normal maps to worker_model_normal, large to worker_model; a brief without a Size line uses worker_model.

worker_model_normal.title: Worker model, normal briefs
worker_model_normal.description: Model alias for workers whose brief says `Size: normal`.

explore_model.title: Explore model
explore_model.description: Model alias for read-only Explore sub-agents started by flow agents (not by the main session) when they name no model.

conflict_model.title: Conflict model
conflict_model.description: Model alias for the sub-agent the reviewer starts to resolve a merge conflict in code files or a combination failure.

manager_model.title: Manager model
manager_model.description: Model alias for managers. Set explicitly so it does not follow the main session's model.

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model alias for the reviewer. Set explicitly so it does not follow the main session's model.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language agents write PRs, briefs and reports in.

preflight.title: Pre-flight
preflight.description: on: a manager files a pre-flight (acceptance criteria, what already shipped, dependencies, questions) before it may start workers, and you get one combined round of the questions. off: managers start workers at once. A task whose prompt has the line `Pre-flight: skip` is exempt.

preflight_wait.title: Pre-flight wait (minutes)
preflight_wait.description: How long a round waits for managers that have not filed before it goes to you without them.

release.title: Release at merge
release.description: on: workers add changelog lines under `## [Unreleased]` and never change the version; the reviewer, once per batch after merging, moves them into a new version section, bumps the version files (patch by default; minor or major when a PR asks with the handover `release` field or a flow:minor / flow:major label) and commits "Release x.y.z". off: nothing changes.

changelog_file.title: Changelog file
changelog_file.description: The changelog (Keep a Changelog style) the release cuts.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.description: auto: after each PR the reviewer merges, and when the reviewer ends, remove worktrees and local branches of finished work that are clean and on the base or in a merged PR. off: only /flow clean. Uncommitted, unpushed, locked and live work is never removed.

worker_harness.title: Worker harness
worker_harness.description: What managers start workers with: agent (a flow:worker in this session), or a harness run in a terminal: claude, codex, gemini, opencode, or a name from the harnesses setting. Managers can still pick another one per worker.

session_host.title: Session host
session_host.description: Where workers in other harnesses run: auto (Orca when it is running, else tmux), orca or tmux.

harnesses.title: Harnesses
harnesses.description: JSON object of harness name to a start command line, or to {start, resume?, program?, quota?, digest?}, over the built-ins, e.g. {"aider": {"start": "aider --yes-always --message-file {prompt_file}", "resume": "aider --restore-chat-history"}}. {prompt} is the prompt as one shell word, {prompt_file} its path; quota is a shell command printing a percent left; digest is codex-rollout or claude-transcript; "" removes a built-in.

min_quota.title: Minimum harness quota
min_quota.description: A session worker whose harness reports its quota (codex built in, or a harness with a quota command) is refused, and the manager starts an agent worker instead, when less than this percent is left. 0: never refused.

base_branch.title: Base branch
base_branch.description: Branch PRs target and the reviewer pushes to. Empty: the remote's default branch.
